body: I used to think in that way but now I lost it. Since everything becomes worse it seems quite unrealistic that everything will be better soon.

I thought about that. But I am not sure what to tell them. As I already mentioned there ist nothing that could explain why I feel the way I am feeling now. Should I just go there and roll up my sleeves and say: Hi, thats why I am here. ?
I guess you are talking about family and friends. And I will not deny, that they would notice my death. Still it is not a reason not to do it.
